localBiteReport: As of the week of September 18–24, 2026 (the most recent report available at time of writing), the inshore bite around Destin and Choctawhatchee Bay is described by Capt. Adam Schroeder of Ignite The Bite Charters as one of the best of the year. Redfish — both slot fish and bull reds — are active around bridges, jetties, and structure, with an outgoing tide being the most productive window; Capt. Schroeder favors live croakers and spot minnows for targeting larger reds at the bridges. Flounder and speckled trout are also in the mix, with bait (scaled sardines, greenies) now easy to find in the mornings and pushing onto the flats and into bayous, making the fall transition noticeably underway. Water temperature at the bay today is 85°F. Anglers should note these reports are from the week of September 18–24; no newer NW Florida inshore-specific report was published as of September 29.
